design: R2.1 Track 1 (docs/v5_plan.md): fixed before any result is seen. No selection by paper findings.
selection: Keep eligible works in response order. Take one from each query q01 to q10 per round; skip an already selected DOI (case-insensitive) or OpenAlex id. Stop at 30 or exhaustion. rank_in_query is the original one-based response position, including ineligible works.
download: Write pdf/<OpenAlex short id>.pdf through a temporary name, then rename. Reuse existing valid PDFs. Require %PDF- and at most 25 MiB. Record failures and take the next unique candidate in the same round-robin order until 30 PDFs exist or candidates run out. Retain failed attempts in the metadata CSV.
cache: Cache each raw response once as data/raw/openalex/<date>/<query id>.json; never fetch it again. No API key, e-mail or personal data in request parameters or headers.
